subproblem.title: Integrality, measurability and local integrability pull back along a parametrization dominated by Hⁿ
subproblem.statement: Let n, P ∈ ℕ, Lⁿ := volume on ℝⁿ = Euclid n, Hⁿ := μHE[n] on ℝ^P = Euclid P, let D ⊆ ℝⁿ be open and Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P continuous on D, and assume the domination (MB): ∫⁻_A f(Φ(v)) dLⁿ(v) ≤ ∫⁻_{Φ(A)} f dHⁿ for every Borel A ⊆ D and every Borel f : ℝ^P → [0, ∞]. Let F : ℝ^P → [0, ∞] be Borel with ∫⁻_{Φ(K)} F dHⁿ ≠ ∞ for every compact K ⊆ D, and let g : ℝ^P → ℝ be a.e.-strongly measurable for Hⁿ⌞Φ(D) such that for Hⁿ⌞Φ(D)-a.e. x, g(x) is an integer and ‖g(x)‖ₑ ≤ F(x). Then G := g∘Φ is locally integrable on D with respect to Lⁿ, and G(v) is an integer for Lⁿ⌞D-a.e. v.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (n P : ℕ) (Φ : Euclid n → Euclid P) (D : Set (Euclid n)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (F : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen D → ContinuousOn Φ D → (∀ (A : Set (Euclid n)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), MeasurableSet A → A ⊆ D → Measurable f → ∫⁻ v in A, f (Φ v) ≤ ∫⁻ x in Φ '' A, f x ∂μHE[n]) → Measurable F → (∀ K : Set (Euclid n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ D → ∫⁻ x in Φ '' K, F x ∂μHE[n] ≠ ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable g (μHE[n].restrict (Φ '' D)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (Φ '' D)), (∃ m : ℤ, g x = m) ∧ ‖g x‖ₑ ≤ F x) → LocallyIntegrableOn (fun v => g (Φ v)) D volume ∧ ∀ᵐ v ∂(volume.restrict D), ∃ m : ℤ, g (Φ v) = m
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 6 ('Transfer to D', parts (a)–(c)) of the parent-supplied proof of dgcr_graph_integer_density_on_graph, with the graph map Φ(v) = z + ιv + ι'u(v), the disc D = B_s(0), the bound θ·1_M and the uncle inequality MB(i) of dgcr_graph_measure_bounds generalized to an arbitrary Φ continuous on an open D, an arbitrary Borel bound F with finite integrals over images of compacta, and the domination inequality as a hypothesis. The domination hypothesis has exactly the shape of part (i) of the parent's prerequisite MB, which the parent applies when it uses this child; this child itself uses no other DAG node. In the grandparent proof this is steps 8(a) and 12(a)–(b). The argument is copied: domination of the push-forward, a.e. transfer, measurability transfer, and the integrability estimate on compacta; step 6(a)'s explicit Borel null set N' is replaced by the equivalent filter statement ae_of_ae_map.
Notation: Lⁿ⌞D := volume.restrict D; Φ_#(Lⁿ⌞D) := Measure.map Φ (volume.restrict D); G(v) := g(Φ(v)); ‖·‖ₑ is the extended norm.
Formalization note: unless this child is split further it is a machine leaf: one theorem appended to the frozen GMT/Ch07/Submission.lean (inside `namespace Submission`), with no new import and no helper declaration. It uses no sibling or uncle declaration; every lemma cited below is in the import closure of GMT.Ch07.Submission (Mathlib 25730c7c, simongmt 2b36630, project b4d606d).
1. D is open, hence Borel (IsOpen.measurableSet); Φ is continuous on the Borel set D, hence AE-measurable for Lⁿ⌞D (ContinuousOn.aemeasurable).
2. Domination of the push-forward: Φ_#(Lⁿ⌞D) ≤ Hⁿ⌞Φ(D). By Measure.le_iff it suffices to compare the two measures on a Borel set B ⊆ ℝ^P. The indicator 1_B : ℝ^P → [0, ∞] is Borel (measurable_one.indicator). Then Φ_#(Lⁿ⌞D)(B) = ∫⁻ 1_B dΦ_#(Lⁿ⌞D) (lintegral_indicator_one) = ∫⁻_D 1_B(Φ(v)) dLⁿ(v) (lintegral_map', using step 1 and AE-measurability of 1_B) ≤ ∫⁻_{Φ(D)} 1_B dHⁿ ((MB) with A := D and f := 1_B) = (Hⁿ⌞Φ(D))(B) (lintegral_indicator_one). The integral form is used because Φ⁻¹(B) need not be Borel (Φ is arbitrary off D).
3. A.e. transfer. By step 2, every property that holds Hⁿ⌞Φ(D)-a.e. holds Φ_#(Lⁿ⌞D)-a.e. (ae_mono), and then, Φ being AE-measurable, for Lⁿ⌞D-a.e. v the property holds at Φ(v) (ae_of_ae_map). Applied to the hypothesis on g: for Lⁿ⌞D-a.e. v, G(v) = g(Φ(v)) is an integer and ‖G(v)‖ₑ ≤ F(Φ(v)). The first half is the integrality conclusion.
4. Measurability. g is a.e.-strongly measurable for Φ_#(Lⁿ⌞D) ≤ Hⁿ⌞Φ(D) (AEStronglyMeasurable.mono_measure with step 2), so G = g∘Φ is a.e.-strongly measurable for Lⁿ⌞D (AEStronglyMeasurable.comp_aemeasurable with step 1), hence for Lⁿ⌞K for every K ⊆ D (AEStronglyMeasurable.mono_set).
5. Local integrability. D is open, hence locally closed (IsOpen.isLocallyClosed), and ℝⁿ is locally compact, so by locallyIntegrableOn_iff it suffices to show that G is integrable on every compact K ⊆ D. Such a K is closed, hence Borel (IsCompact.isClosed). By step 4, G is a.e.-strongly measurable on K. By step 3 restricted to K ⊆ D (ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset), ‖G(v)‖ₑ ≤ F(Φ(v)) for Lⁿ⌞K-a.e. v, so ∫⁻_K ‖G‖ₑ dLⁿ ≤ ∫⁻_K F(Φ(v)) dLⁿ(v) (lintegral_mono_ae) ≤ ∫⁻_{Φ(K)} F dHⁿ ((MB) with A := K and f := F, F Borel) < ∞ (hypothesis). Thus G has finite integral on K (hasFiniteIntegral_iff_enorm) and IntegrableOn G K. Hence G is locally integrable on D. ∎

```lean
theorem dgid_dominated_pullback_integer_locallyIntegrable : ∀ (n P : ℕ) (Φ : Euclid n → Euclid P) (D : Set (Euclid n)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (F : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen D → ContinuousOn Φ D → (∀ (A : Set (Euclid n)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), MeasurableSet A → A ⊆ D → Measurable f → ∫⁻ v in A, f (Φ v) ≤ ∫⁻ x in Φ '' A, f x ∂μHE[n]) → Measurable F → (∀ K : Set (Euclid n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ D → ∫⁻ x in Φ '' K, F x ∂μHE[n] ≠ ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable g (μHE[n].restrict (Φ '' D)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (Φ '' D)), (∃ m : ℤ, g x = m) ∧ ‖g x‖ₑ ≤ F x) → LocallyIntegrableOn (fun v => g (Φ v)) D volume ∧ ∀ᵐ v ∂(volume.restrict D), ∃ m : ℤ, g (Φ v) = m := by
  intro n P Φ D g F hD hΦ hMB hF hfin hg hae
  have hDm : MeasurableSet D := hD.measurableSet
  have hΦae : AEMeasurable Φ (volume.restrict D) := hΦ.aemeasurable hDm
  have hle : Measure.map Φ (volume.restrict D) ≤ μHE[n].restrict (Φ '' D) := by
    rw [Measure.le_iff]
    intro B hB
    have hind : Measurable (B.indicator (1 : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞)) := measurable_one.indicator hB
    rw [← lintegral_indicator_one hB, ← lintegral_indicator_one hB,
      lintegral_map' hind.aemeasurable hΦae]
    exact hMB D _ hDm subset_rfl hind
  have hae' : ∀ᵐ v ∂(volume.restrict D), (∃ m : ℤ, g (Φ v) = m) ∧ ‖g (Φ v)‖ₑ ≤ F (Φ v) :=
    ae_of_ae_map hΦae (ae_mono hle hae)
  have hGm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun v => g (Φ v)) (volume.restrict D) :=
    (hg.mono_measure hle).comp_aemeasurable hΦae
  refine ⟨?_, hae'.mono fun v hv => hv.1⟩
  rw [locallyIntegrableOn_iff hD.isLocallyClosed]
  intro K hKD hK
  refine ⟨hGm.mono_set hKD, ?_⟩
  rw [hasFiniteIntegral_iff_enorm]
  calc ∫⁻ v in K, ‖g (Φ v)‖ₑ ≤ ∫⁻ v in K, F (Φ v) :=
        lintegral_mono_ae (ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset hKD (hae'.mono fun v hv => hv.2))
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ x in Φ '' K, F x ∂μHE[n] := hMB K F hK.isClosed.measurableSet hKD hF
    _ < ∞ := lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr (hfin K hK hKD)
```
proof_key_steps: Φ is AE-measurable for Lⁿ⌞D (ContinuousOn.aemeasurable); (MB) with A := D and f := 1_B gives Φ_#(Lⁿ⌞D)(B) = ∫⁻_D 1_B∘Φ ≤ Hⁿ(Φ(D) ∩ B) for Borel B, so Φ_#(Lⁿ⌞D) ≤ Hⁿ⌞Φ(D).
ae_mono and ae_of_ae_map transfer 'g ∈ ℤ and ‖g‖ₑ ≤ F' from Hⁿ⌞Φ(D)-a.e. x to Lⁿ⌞D-a.e. v at x = Φ(v); this gives integrality.
mono_measure and comp_aemeasurable make G = g∘Φ a.e.-strongly measurable for Lⁿ⌞D.
For compact K ⊆ D: ∫⁻_K ‖G‖ₑ ≤ ∫⁻_K F∘Φ ≤ ∫⁻_{Φ(K)} F dHⁿ < ∞; locallyIntegrableOn_iff for the open D gives local integrability.

audit.reason: Measurable indicators establish push-forward domination using only a.e. measurability of Φ on D. The direction of domination correctly transfers integrality, the norm bound and strong measurability. The compact-set estimate gives finite integral, and the locally closed criterion yields local integrability. Every required hypothesis is explicit. Domination and the properties of g are hypotheses, so the empty dependency list is correct.
